name: Nox
source:
Nox, another name for the night. He was the last general to be created; Paw made him, yet I never saw them close with each other.

Maybe it has to do with how he's often asking questions that don't really have any answers to them. The other generals don't seem to be interested in his questions, guess that's why he bothers me with them most of the time.

At least he's pretty dependable and skilled...a little to skilled, I just can't beat the guy in any 2P matches.

- Kobu's journal entry on Nox
